note: Rewritten from Light 1930 (the Amitermes of Mexico), pp. 223—224; original in English; columns A and B of the soldier table are two specimens. The original "gula" denotes the postmentum (the gular plate) and is rendered postmentum.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alates not described. Soldier of the emersoni species group: head long and narrow, rectangular in dorsal view, slightly narrowed only at the anterior end (at the antennal sockets), head index about 0.80; mandibles only weakly convex, apex not strongly curved inward; postmentum constriction index about 0.70. In the key it differs from A. emersoni as follows: mandibles very weakly curved, tooth very sharp, head sides nearly parallel posteriorly. Worker medium-sized, head width less than 1.15 mm; head pale yellow; antennae very short, nymph-like; clypeus about as long as wide.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Body generally white to pale yellow, only the mandibles pale reddish brown. Head rectangular in dorsal view, narrowed only from the antennal sockets, much longer than wide; head index about 0.80; head constriction index about 0.82; head sides nearly straight; posterior margin weakly convex, posterior corners short and rounded. Mandibles distinctly shorter than the head, weakly and evenly convex, apex only slightly curved inward, head-mandible index about 0.80; tooth at the outer third of the mandible, slender, directed basally, like a barb on a hook. Antennae very slender, 15-segmented, pale yellow throughout; postmentum gradually and deeply constricted at the middle, postmentum constriction index less than 0.70. Measurements (mm; two soldiers, A, B): head length 1.44 (A), 1.52 (B); minimum head width 1.01 (A), 1.05 (B); maximum head width 1.14 (A), 1.14 (B); distance between the anterior lateral corners of the head capsule 0.88; mandible length 1.34 (A), 1.28 (B); postmentum length 0.76; maximum postmentum width 0.40; minimum postmentum width 0.26; pronotum width 0.75 (A), 0.74 (B); head index 0.79 (A), 0.75 (B); head constriction index 0.89 (A), 0.92 (B); head constriction index taking the distance between the anterior lateral corners of the head capsule as the minimum width 0.77; head-mandible index 0.93 (A), 0.84 (B); postmentum constriction index 0.65; mandible length used to calculate mandible curvature index II 1.28; minimum mandible curvature 0.11; mandible curvature index II 0.86.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Medium-sized, body generally pale, abdomen greyish black owing to the contents. Head very pale yellow; antennae very short, nymph-like, slightly yellow apically. Clypeus long, as long as the labrum, its length close to the width at the base, sides constricted but straight. Measurements (mm; 5 workers, minimum—maximum—mean): head length 0.93—0.95—0.94; head width 1.05—1.11—1.08; pronotum width 0.59—0.67—0.63.
